description: This Java class, GenericHelperFactory, provides a factory method to instantiate and cache instances of GenericHelper based on configuration data. It includes logic for dynamic class loading, constructor invocation, and thread-safe caching.

classes.name: GenericHelperFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and caching instances of GenericHelper based on helper information and datasource configuration.

methods.name: getHelper
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a GenericHelper instance corresponding to the provided helperInfo. Utilizes double-checked locking for thread safety and dynamic class loading.
